name: Decoupled DAG with Palette Compression
aliases: Geometry and Attribute Compression for Voxel Scenes
definition: A method to compress arbitrary voxel data (colors, normals, reflectance) by decoupling geometry topology from voxel attributes. It uses a DAG to encode the topology (geometry) and a palette-based compression scheme for the extracted attributes, allowing efficient GPU storage and real-time raytracing.
summary: Decoupled DAG with Palette Compression separates voxel geometry from attributes to enable efficient GPU storage and real-time raytracing, unlike standard DAGs restricted to single-bit geometry.
